detail: Losing a small amount of weight if you have overweight. A small amount of weight loss means around 5% to 7% of your body

record.canonicalName: Losing a small amount of weight if you have overweight

properties.name: Losing a small amount of weight if you have overweight
properties.expectedBenefit: Lower your risk for type 2 diabetes by 58% (71% if you're over age 60)

record.quote: Losing a small amount of weight if you have overweight. A small amount of weight loss means around 5% to 7% of your body weight. That's around 10 to 14 pounds for a 200-pound person.

propertyEvidence.activityTarget: A small amount of weight loss means around 5% to 7% of your body weight. That's around 10 to 14 pounds for a 200-pound person.
propertyEvidence.expectedBenefit: The CDC-led National Diabetes Prevention Program can help you make those changes—and make them stick. Through the program, you can lower your risk for type 2 diabetes by 58% (71% if you're over age 60).
